business_goal: Allow customers to securely access their accounts. Provide a personalized shopping experience. Protect user data and prevent unauthorized access. Increase customer trust in the e-commerce platform.
out_of_scope: Unrelated features are not included in this iteration.

functional_requirements.description: Check whether the account is active.
Redirect the user to their account page.
Users should be able to log in using email and password.
The system should validate user credentials.
The system should create a secure session after successful login.
The system should allow users to log out.
The system should provide password reset functionality.
The system should prevent unauthorized access to user accounts.

non_functional_requirements.description: Login response time should be less than 2 seconds.
The system should use HTTPS for secure communication.
The system should support multiple users at the same time.
User sessions should expire after a defined period of inactivity.

acceptance_criteria.description: The feature must satisfy the approved functional requirements.

output_requirements: The system should return a clear success or failure response.

validation_rules.description: Input values must be validated before processing.

constraints: Limit the number of failed login attempts.
Temporarily lock the account after multiple failed attempts.
Do not reveal whether the email or password is incorrect.
Record failed login attempts for security monitoring.
